evals.name: apns-registration-permission-review
evals.prompt: Review this SwiftUI push setup: it only calls registerForRemoteNotifications after the user grants alert permission, stores the APNs token in UserDefaults so it can skip uploads on future launches, and treats a simulator failure as a production bug. What should change?
evals.expected_output: A correction-focused review that separates APNs token registration from user-visible notification authorization, uploads APNs tokens on every callback without local token caching, and handles simulator push testing correctly.
assertions: Explains that requestAuthorization is for alerts, sounds, and badges, while registerForRemoteNotifications is the APNs token registration path.
Says APNs registration should not be gated on .authorized when the app needs silent pushes or server token binding.
Requires sending the device token to the provider server on every didRegister callback and not persisting it locally as a source of truth.

Distinguishes provider-free .apns/simctl simulation from APNs Sandbox registration on supported current Simulator hosts, and requires physical-device verification for production or hardware-specific behavior.

evals.name: background-push-payload-review
evals.prompt: A backend wants to keep chat fresh with silent pushes every few minutes and apns-priority 10. The app already has visible notification UI elsewhere. Review only the APNs payload, headers, and app-side notification handling.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded review that requires a background payload and headers, rejects high-priority/frequent silent pushes, names the Remote notifications background mode, and keeps long-running background work in the background-processing boundary.
assertions: Requires aps content-available: 1 with no alert, sound, or badge for a background notification.
Warns that background notifications are low priority, throttled, not guaranteed, and should not be sent every few minutes.
Requires Background Modes > Remote notifications and prompt UIBackgroundFetchResult completion.
Keeps visible-notification UI and long-running BGTaskScheduler work out of the push-notifications scope except as handoffs.

evals.name: rich-notification-extension-review
evals.prompt: Review a rich-notification plan: use mutable-content on a silent push to decrypt text, store the decryption key in an App Group UserDefaults suite, attach a downloaded file from any URL, use INSendMessageIntent without extra capability setup, and skip explicit fallback handling when work fails or time expires.
evals.expected_output: A review that corrects service-extension triggering, secure shared storage, attachment handling, communication notification setup, and fallback behavior for failed or timed-out service-extension work.
assertions: Says a Notification Service Extension requires mutable-content: 1 and an alerting remote notification; silent pushes do not trigger it.
Uses Keychain Sharing for decryption secrets and App Groups only for shared files or UserDefaults.
Requires attachments to be supported files on disk and notes the system validates and stores them.
Requires Communication Notifications capability, NSUserActivityTypes intent entries, intent donation, and content.updating(from:).
Requires calling the content handler exactly once on success, failure, and serviceExtensionTimeWillExpire timeout paths with original, best-attempt, or updated content.

evals.name: local-calendar-reminder-reference-routing
evals.prompt: Add a daily 8:30 AM local medication reminder that users can edit or disable. Keep the answer scoped to on-device scheduling; the app has no notification server, rich media, or Live Activity.
evals.expected_output: A focused local-notification plan that models authorization, stable request ownership, calendar scheduling, update/removal, time behavior, and verification without introducing APNs or extension infrastructure.
assertions: Uses UNCalendarNotificationTrigger and discusses the intended wall-clock, time-zone, or daylight-saving behavior rather than treating a fixed interval as a daily calendar reminder.
Uses a stable UNNotificationRequest identifier so editing replaces the intended pending request and disabling removes both pending and, when appropriate, delivered notifications.
Checks current notification settings and preserves the in-app reminder state when visible notification authorization is unavailable.
Verifies the next trigger date, pending requests, edit/disable behavior, large localized content, and relevant time-zone transitions.
Does not introduce APNs registration, a provider server, a notification service extension, or Live Activity handling for this local-only request.
